INSERT INTO mr0_universe_snapshot (provider_code, canonical_symbol, symbol, name, market, total_market_cap, circulating_market_cap, turnover_rate, as_of_date, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.providerCode}, #{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.symbol}, #{item.name}, #{item.market}, #{item.totalMarketCap}, #{item.circulatingMarketCap}, #{item.turnoverRate}, #{item.asOfDate}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE symbol = VALUES(symbol), name = VALUES(name), market = VALUES(market), total_market_cap = VALUES(total_market_cap), circulating_market_cap = VALUES(circulating_market_cap), turnover_rate = VALUES(turnover_rate), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)

INSERT INTO mr0_industry_membership (taxonomy_code, provider_code, industry_code, industry_name, canonical_symbol, as_of_date, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.taxonomyCode}, #{item.providerCode}, #{item.industryCode}, #{item.industryName}, #{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.asOfDate}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE industry_name = VALUES(industry_name), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)

INSERT INTO mr0_stock_money_flow_daily (canonical_symbol, trade_date, provider_code, main_net_inflow, main_net_inflow_ratio, super_net, industry_code, industry_net_inflow, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.providerCode}, #{item.mainNetInflow}, #{item.mainNetInflowRatio}, #{item.superNet}, #{item.industryCode}, #{item.industryNetInflow}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE main_net_inflow = VALUES(main_net_inflow), main_net_inflow_ratio = VALUES(main_net_inflow_ratio), super_net = VALUES(super_net), industry_code = VALUES(industry_code), industry_net_inflow = VALUES(industry_net_inflow), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)

INSERT INTO stock_daily_bar (canonical_symbol, trade_date, adjust_type, data_source, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, amount, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.adjustType}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.openPrice}, #{item.highPrice}, #{item.lowPrice}, #{item.closePrice}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amount}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
